name: bunny-plugin
description: Bunny for OpenAI agents — operate a live Bunny billing account through MCP tools, plus developer skills for docs, GraphQL and SDK integration

interface.shortDescription: Run your Bunny billing account from chat — customers, subscriptions, quotes, invoices and revenue.
interface.longDescription: Connect your Bunny account and work with it directly: look up customers and subscriptions, answer revenue questions like MRR, churn and retention, preview the next invoice, build products and pricing, and raise quotes to change or cancel a subscription. Also includes the developer skills — searching live Bunny documentation, generating and validating GraphQL, and guided integrations for the Node and Ruby SDKs, the @bunnyapp/components React library, webhooks and the customer portal.
defaultPrompt: Which of my customers have invoices more than 90 days overdue?
What was our MRR last quarter, and what drove the change?
Give Acme Corp 20% off their Enterprise subscription
What will Acme be invoiced next month?
Set up a new product with a monthly plan at $50 per seat
